SELECT d.id, d.name, d.title, d.gender, d.avatar, d.intro, d.status, d.department_id, dept.name AS departmentName, u.username AS username FROM doctor d LEFT JOIN department dept ON d.department_id = dept.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.doctor_id = d.id
AND d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.name}, '%')
AND dept.name = #{query.departmentName}
ORDER BY d.id DESC
